name: issue-drafter
description: Draft a GitHub issue title, labels, and body that mirror the target repo issue form. Does not call gh issue create.

inputs.name: idea
inputs.description: Prompt text for a future implementation idea, or a pasted feature-brief.

inputs.name: intake-summary
inputs.description: Framed idea, resolved owner/name, issue kind, and matching form file when one exists.

inputs.name: overlap-report
inputs.description: Related open and closed issues with links, plus whether drafting must stop.

inputs.name: template-excerpt
inputs.description: Chosen form path, title prefix, labels, and required field labels.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional answers accumulated across clarification loops.

outputs.name: issue-draft
outputs.description: Repository, title, labels, markdown body, and related links. Empty when drafting is blocked.
